# Innovation Built Around Real Healthcare Needs

AliMed has always been shaped by a simple idea: better solutions start with understanding the
everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

everyday challenges of caregivers, patients, and healthcare facilities. From value-based products
designed to support safety and productivity to new materials that help improve comfort, durability,
and performance, our innovation is rooted in practical solutions for all care environments.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

### WE ARE THE SOLE DISTRIBUTOR OF RIFTON PRODUCTS IN SINGAPORE

[VIEW RIFTON PRODUCTS][247]

DNR Wheels has been positioned as a leading provider of senior care and elderly assist products in
Singapore for over 30 years since 1994. From our humble beginnings, we have grown to be a reliable
market leader, offering one-stop mobility solutions and a diverse array of recommended elderly care
equipment solutions.

Our mission is deeply rooted in enhancing the lives of the infirmed and elderly, whether they face a
temporary or permanent disability. We’re dedicated to enabling independence and comfort by serving
hospitals, eldercare facilities, healthcare providers, caregivers, and individuals with the finest
rehabilitative products and mobility equipment. We’re thrilled to contribute significantly to the
improvement of lives through our commitment to accessibility and quality.
* Curated Selection of Premium Elderly Assist Products
* Benefit from a Personalised Assessment with Therapists
* Bespoke Customisation, Service and Maintenance
* Established Reputation as a Disability Equipment Supplier in Singapore

### ONE-STOP ELDERLY CARE EQUIPMENT SOLUTIONS

DNR is proud to be among the trusted disability equipment suppliers in Singapore for healthcare
providers and individuals. We offer a full spectrum of affordable mobility equipment for seniors in
Singapore, offering products certified for nursing homes and hospital-grade use. This ensures
patient comfort and care is always met with the highest standards.

### WE ARE THE SOLE DISTRIBUTOR OF RIFTON PRODUCTS IN SINGAPORE

[VIEW RIFTON PRODUCTS][247]

DNR Wheels has been positioned as a leading provider of senior care and elderly assist products in
Singapore for over 30 years since 1994. From our humble beginnings, we have grown to be a reliable
market leader, offering one-stop mobility solutions and a diverse array of recommended elderly care
equipment solutions.

Our mission is deeply rooted in enhancing the lives of the infirmed and elderly, whether they face a
temporary or permanent disability. We’re dedicated to enabling independence and comfort by serving
hospitals, eldercare facilities, healthcare providers, caregivers, and individuals with the finest
rehabilitative products and mobility equipment. We’re thrilled to contribute significantly to the
improvement of lives through our commitment to accessibility and quality.
* Curated Selection of Premium Elderly Assist Products
* Benefit from a Personalised Assessment with Therapists
* Bespoke Customisation, Service and Maintenance
* Established Reputation as a Disability Equipment Supplier in Singapore

### ONE-STOP ELDERLY CARE EQUIPMENT SOLUTIONS

DNR is proud to be among the trusted disability equipment suppliers in Singapore for healthcare
providers and individuals. We offer a full spectrum of affordable mobility equipment for seniors in
Singapore, offering products certified for nursing homes and hospital-grade use. This ensures
patient comfort and care is always met with the highest standards.

* ### [How to choose an electric wheelchair suitable for the elderly?][157]
  
  1. Safety: The elderly and the disabled have limited mobility and use electric wheelchairs to
  ensure safety is the first priority.
  The safety design of the [outdoor electric wheelchair][158] mainly includes: anti-backward small
  wheels, seat belts, anti-skid tires, electromagnetic brakes, and differential motors. In addition,
  two points should be noted: first, the center of gravity of the electric wheelchair should not be
  too high; second, the wheelchair will not slide on the slope and can stop smoothly.
  2. Comfort
  Comfort mainly refers to the seat system of the wheelchair, involving seat width, cushion
  material, backrest height, etc. Cushion material and backrest height, generally sofa chair + high
  backrest is the most comfortable.
  3. Portability
  Portability is the biggest point linked to personal needs. Pure mobility wheelchairs are generally
  easy to fold and store, while functional wheelchairs and long battery life are relatively heavy
  and not portable.

* ### [How to choose an electric wheelchair suitable for the elderly?][157]
  
  1. Safety: The elderly and the disabled have limited mobility and use electric wheelchairs to
  ensure safety is the first priority.
  The safety design of the [outdoor electric wheelchair][158] mainly includes: anti-backward small
  wheels, seat belts, anti-skid tires, electromagnetic brakes, and differential motors. In addition,
  two points should be noted: first, the center of gravity of the electric wheelchair should not be
  too high; second, the wheelchair will not slide on the slope and can stop smoothly.
  2. Comfort
  Comfort mainly refers to the seat system of the wheelchair, involving seat width, cushion
  material, backrest height, etc. Cushion material and backrest height, generally sofa chair + high
  backrest is the most comfortable.
  3. Portability
  Portability is the biggest point linked to personal needs. Pure mobility wheelchairs are generally
  easy to fold and store, while functional wheelchairs and long battery life are relatively heavy
  and not portable.

★ An America 250 celebration ★

# Freedom to *move*.

America turns 250 this year, and we are celebrating the freedom that matters most at our house: the
freedom to get up and go. Meet the In-Motion Freedom Crutch, lightweight ergonomic underarm crutches
from Millennial Medical, a family company in St. George, Utah.

[Shop the Freedom Crutch][3] [Meet Millennial Medical][4]

Lightweight aluminum · Ergonomic handles · Articulating tips

[A pair of In-Motion Freedom underarm crutches crossed in front of a white background]

The In-Motion Freedom Crutch, by Millennial Medical

★ Why people love it ★

## Independence, engineered

★

### Light on your arms

High-quality lightweight aluminum with contoured left and right handles that keep your wrists in a
natural position, so getting around takes less out of you.

★

### Grips the ground

Articulating tips stay flat through your stride on sidewalks, grass, gravel, and hardwood. Parade
routes and backyard barbecues included.

★

### Family made

Designed by Millennial Medical, a family crutch company in St. George, Utah, and backed by the same
crew that answers the phone when you call.

★ Freedom looks like this ★

## Wherever the celebration is, get there

[Woman walking a coastal path using In-Motion Freedom crutches] Boardwalks, beach paths, and
everywhere between. [Woman resting on outdoor steps with her In-Motion Freedom crutches beside her]
Take the break. The crutches will be ready when you are.

★ Will it fit? ★

## Sized for most, with a bigger family behind it

The Freedom Crutch is a universal underarm crutch that fits users from 4'6" to 5'10", rated to 300
lbs. Taller, or want spring-assisted shock absorption? The In-Motion Pro line from Millennial
Medical covers forearm users to 6'8" and underarm users to 7'1", rated to 350 lbs.

[Freedom Crutch →][5] [In-Motion Pro Underarm →][6] [In-Motion Pro Forearm →][7] [Full sizing chart
→][8]

★ ★ ★

## 250 years of moving forward.

Here's to the next step. Happy 250th, America.

With the aging of the population, the elderly have become the largest user group in the Obese people

## Disabled People

The main function of mobility&rehabilitation aids is to assist the disabled in their food, clothing,
housing and transportation, help them improve their physical functions and improve their ability to
take care of themselves. We are happy to provide help to the disabled.

## Injured People

Including patients who have just been injured, patients who have been bedridden for a long time,
patients who need to recover after surgery, etc., mobility&rehabilitation aids can help them relieve
pain and assist in restoring their physical functions.

## Children & Teenagers

Pediatric walkers and wheelchairs are suitable for children and teenagers to help them adapt to the
challenges brought about by changes in physical development.

## Obese People

Obese people usually need to use some mobility&rehabilitation aids to help them maintain physical
activities, such as orthotics, wheelchairs, etc., which can also help them better adapt to their
physical conditions and improve their quality of life.

## Home use

In the home scene, the users are usually family members or individual users, who usually have higher
autonomy and self-management capabilities. Therefore, the design of mobility&rehabilitation aids in
the home scene is usually more humane, easy to operate and use, and comfort and aesthetics must also
be considered. Some assistive devices in the home scene may also be equipped with intelligent
functions, such as remote monitoring, data collection, etc., so that users and families can better
understand the usage.

## Hospital, Nursing Homes, Senior Apartments, Community & Rehabilitation Centers

In public scenarios such as hospitals, users are usually patients or injured patients. The physical
conditions of these people are usually special and require more professional and targeted
mobility&rehabilitation aids design. The design of mobility&rehabilitation aids in public scenarios
usually pays more attention to safety and stability to ensure the safety and comfort of users. In
addition, mobility&rehabilitation aids in public scenarios also need to consider medical management
needs, such as equipment management, data recording, etc.

Fulfill Your Custom Mobility & Rehabilitation Aids Needs

## Elderly People

With the aging of the population, the elderly have become the largest user group in the Obese people
usually need to use some assistive devices to help them maintain physical activities, such as
orthotics, wheelchairs, etc.,

## Disabled People

The main function of mobility&rehabilitation aids is to assist the disabled in their food, clothing,
housing and transportation, help them improve their physical functions and improve their ability to
take care of themselves. We are happy to provide help to the disabled.

## Injured People

Including patients who have just been injured, patients who have been bedridden for a long time,
patients who need to recover after surgery, etc., mobility&rehabilitation aids can help them relieve
pain and assist in restoring their physical functions.

## Children & Teenagers

Pediatric walkers and wheelchairs are suitable for children and teenagers to help them adapt to the
challenges brought about by changes in physical development.

## Obese People

Obese people usually need to use some mobility&rehabilitation aids to help them maintain physical
activities, such as orthotics, wheelchairs, etc., which can also help them better adapt to their
physical conditions and improve their quality of life.

## Home use

In the home scene, the users are usually family members or individual users, who usually have higher
autonomy and self-management capabilities. Therefore, the design of mobility&rehabilitation aids in
the home scene is usually more humane, easy to operate and use, and comfort and aesthetics must also
be considered. Some assistive devices in the home scene may also be equipped with intelligent
functions, such as remote monitoring, data collection, etc., so that users and families can better
understand the usage.

## Hospital, Nursing Homes, Senior Apartments, Community & Rehabilitation Centers

In public scenarios such as hospitals, users are usually patients or injured patients. The physical
conditions of these people are usually special and require more professional and targeted
mobility&rehabilitation aids design. The design of mobility&rehabilitation aids in public scenarios
usually pays more attention to safety and stability to ensure the safety and comfort of users. In
addition, mobility&rehabilitation aids in public scenarios also need to consider medical management
needs, such as equipment management, data recording, etc.

  [Hospital Movable Commode Chair][96]
  
  Easy Assembly and Portability This hospital commode chair is designed for quick assembly and
  disassembly, facilitating easy transport and storage. Its compact design makes it ideal for
  various settings, including hospitals, nursing homes, and home care environments. The lightweight
  construction of this hospital commode chair allows caregivers to move the chair effortlessly,
  ensuring that patients receive the necessary support wherever they are. Additionally, this movable
  commode chair is built for practicality, making it a convenient solution for caregivers and
  patients alike. Enhanced User Comfort and Safety The hospital commode chair features a comfortable
  seat and backrest, providing essential support during use. The sturdy armrests assist users in
  sitting down and standing up, promoting greater independence. The rear wheel brakes enhance safety
  by preventing unintended movement, ensuring that the hospital commode chair remains secure at all
  times. These essential safety and comfort features make this movable commode chair a reliable
  choice for users with limited mobility, helping them maintain stability and comfort throughout
  use.
  
  [Details][97]

  offering a comfortable solution for prolonged use. The adjustable backrest allows for customizable

## About US

Guangdong Guoyao Medical Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Guoyao Medical") is
headquartered in the Sihui Nanjiang Industrial Park, Zhaoqing City, Guangdong Province, situated in
the world-renowned Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area. Originating from Guoyao Aluminum
Industry founded in 1984, the company's first phase of investment amounts to 68 million yuan,
spanning across 200,000 square meters. It primarily engages in the production and operation of Class
I and Class II medical devices, including crutches, walking aids, bathing chairs, commode chairs,
wheelchairs, shopping carts, nursing beds, and other rehabilitation assistive devices. Guoyao
Medical has obtained ISO 13485 and ISO 9001 quality management system certifications, along with
comprehensive product certifications such as CE and FDA.

## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

[More][58]

## About Us

#### Focus on medical respiratory and rehabilitation equipment production with more than 20 years
#### experience

Jiangsu Jumao X-Care Medical Equipment Co., Ltd. is situated in the Danyang Phoenix Industrial Zone,
Jiangsu Province. Established in 2002, the company boasts a fixed asset investment of 200 million
yuan, spanning an area of 90,000 square meters. We proudly employ over 450 dedicated staff members,
including more than 80 professional and technical personnel. Specializing in the production of
wheelchairs, rollators, oxygen concentrators, patient beds, and other rehabilitation and health care
products, our company is equipped with advanced production and testing facilities. Our commitment to
innovation is evident through our professional R&D teams located in China and Ohio, USA, positioning
us as an industry leader. Many governments and foundations have designated our products for their
medical institutions, reflecting our excellence and reliability.

We foster a spirit of “unity, progress, pragmatism, and efficiency,” building a team renowned for
its effective execution. Our unwavering commitment to quality control ensures that we consistently
uphold our principles of “thorough development, quality-production, customer-trust.” We prioritize
“quality first, reputation first,” aiming to create a bright future in collaboration with our
customers through high-quality, stable, and safe products. Our dedication to quality is demonstrated
by our numerous certifications: ISO 9001: 2015 and IS013485: 2016 quality system certifications;
ISO14001: 2004 environmental system certification, FDA 510 (k) certification for our wheelchairs and
oxygen concentrators in the United States, ETL certification and CE certification for our oxygen
concentrators

We have invested significantly in new product research and development, securing many patents. Our
state-of-the-art facilities include large plastic injection machines, automatic bending machines,
welding robots, automatic wire wheel shaping machines, and other specialized production and testing
equipment. Our integrated manufacturing capabilities encompass precision machining and metal surface
treatment. Our production infrastructure features two advanced automatic spraying production lines
and eight assembly lines, with an impressive annual production capacity of 600,000 pieces.

As we look to the future, we are committed to striving to provide exceptional customer service and
contribute value to society as “JUMAO”. We aim to create new frontiers in the medical industry, hand
in hand with our partners and customers. Join us as we continue to innovate and lead in the field of
medical equipment, dedicated to improving lives and advancing healthcare solutions globally.

[More][58]

# We ensure everyone affected by cancer has the resources they need **to thrive**

In the time it takes you to read this, 19 people will be diagnosed with cancer. Join our fight to
improve their quality of life today—because they deserve more than just hope for a better tomorrow.
[ Donate ][39]

## Cancer survivors need your support.

Livestrong holds Charity Navigator's highest possible rating of 4 stars, showcasing exceptional
financial accountability, transparency, and responsible use of donor dollars.

**$20** a month provides easy-to-digest resources during the first days after diagnosis and beyond

**$50** can support a proven strengthening program like CancerFit

**$100** can give the hope of having children and make family-building a reality

We believe in putting

## PEOPLE FIRST,
## ALWAYS.

For decades, Livestrong has been dedicated to making life easier for cancer survivors—whether they
have just been diagnosed or are years into their journey. We provide answers you can trust, a
network of verified sources, tools to arm yourself with knowledge, and countless other resources to
prepare and empower.  

[ Explore Our Resources ][42]

## How We Help

[ Livestrong Fertility ][43]

If you’ve been diagnosed with cancer, we can help alleviate the burden of preserving fertility with
discounted services and free medications. Our nationwide network of fertility clinics allows you to
focus on treatment without compromising hope for a future family.

[ Livestrong at the YMCA ][44]

Since 2007, we’ve partnered with YMCA of the USA to help strengthen survivors after treatment.
Physical activity has a profound impact on health, so find a branch near you.

[ Advocacy ][45]

We lend our voices at the legislative and federal levels to push for more cancer research and
prevention funding across the country.

[ CancerFit ][46]

Our certified personal trainers learn exercises specially tailored for cancer survivors to help them
get back on their feet after treatment, improving both their quality of life and cancer outcomes.

[ Resources ][47]

Resources like the Livestrong Guidebook, Ellis survivor companion app, and *My Brave Friend
*children’s book are designed to make support accessible.

Our single, urgent goal: Eliminate Parkinson's disease in our lifetime.

### Over $ 2.5 billion funded in research programs to date

## Featured Carousel Gallery

Get Involved

## You too can make a difference.

“Parkinson's patients are the experts on what we have. We have a responsibility as patients to share
our experience — what works for us, what we respond to, what we can contribute to research.”

— Michael J. Fox

Donate
Fundraise
Participate in Research
Advocate
[Researcher holding a tablet with brain scan.]

#### Donate to Research

Your support will help usher in a future without Parkinson's disease.

[ Donate now ][109]
[Male and female couple smiling for the camera at a Tour de Fox cycling event.]

#### Fundraise for a Cure

Thousands of Team Fox members worldwide are turning their passions and interests into millions in
funding for Parkinson's research.

[ Join an event ][110]
[Person with glasses sitting down]

#### Be Part of the Answer

You have the power to impact your future and the future of millions living with Parkinson's disease.
Explore participating in clinical research today.

[ Join a study ][111]
[Two male advocates in front of the United States Capitol building at the Parkinson's Policy Forum.]

#### Public Policy Matters

Your voice and your story can shape policymakers' decisions on issues of importance to the
Parkinson's community.

[ Take action today ][112]
/
[Woman with PD]
“As more patients make the decision to participate in research studies, we’ll continue to make
faster progress toward better treatments and a cure. So, take heart. The future of Parkinson’s
research and care looks bright.”
— Anna Cohn Donnelly, D.P.H., Winnetka, Illinois

“Parkinson's patients are the experts on what we have. We have a responsibility as patients to share
our experience — what works for us, what we respond to, what we can contribute to research.”

— Michael J. Fox

[ Donate now ][109]

funding for Parkinson's research.

[ Join an event ][110]

Parkinson's community.

# NCLEX-RN Tests: Practice Like It’s the Real Exam

Study smarter with authentic NCLEX-style questions organized by the **official NCLEX-RN Test Plan**.
Every item is mapped to the four Client Needs categories, so you always know where to focus—and how
your practice aligns with the real exam.
* **Distraction-free slideshow experience:** flip through questions in a clean, slide-by-slide
  format.
* **Reveal answers only when you’re ready:** tap the info icon—each solution is hidden in the image
  title to keep your thinking independent.
* **Fast, deep navigation:** start at the main category page and drill down to specific subtopics in
  seconds.
* **Always fresh. Always free.** New sets are added regularly—no paywalls, no limits.

### 50-Question Topic Tests (Hundreds of Sets per Subtopic)

Master content systematically with **50-question practice sets** in **every subcategory**. Build
momentum, track progress by topic, and revisit targeted areas as often as you like. With **hundreds
of tests** across subtopics—and more added over time—you’ll always have fresh material to work
through.

### 125-Question Full-Length Exams (Realistic and Balanced)

When you’re ready to simulate the real thing, switch to **125-question comprehensive exams** that
mirror the **official NCLEX-RN content distribution** across the four Client Needs categories:
* **Safe and Effective Care Environment** – Management of Care, Safety & Infection Control,
  Delegation & Prioritization, etc.
* **Health Promotion and Maintenance** – Growth & Development, Prenatal & Newborn Care, Screening &
  Disease Prevention, etc.
* **Psychosocial Integrity** – Coping Mechanisms, Mental Health Disorders, Crisis Intervention, etc.
* **Physiological Integrity** – Pharmacological & Parenteral Therapies, Basic Care & Comfort,
  Reduction of Risk Potential, Physiological Adaptation, etc.

Each full-length exam is **built from a separate, non-overlapping item pool**—so you won’t see
repeats from the 50-question sets—and each release is curated to be **distinct from prior full
exams**. The result: realistic pacing, authentic category balance, and a true confidence check
before test day.

**Choose a category, dive into the questions, and let consistent practice sharpen your clinical
judgment.** The more you work through them, the more second-nature NCLEX-style reasoning becomes.

These are **authentic flashcards shared by real NCLEX candidates**—practical, exam-ready insights
rather than generic summaries. Cards are **organized by the official NCLEX test plan categories**,
so you can find exactly what you need.

**Effortless navigation:** start on the main category page and **click down to the deepest topic

Palmaairport.info is your **go-to guide** for everything you need to know about Palma de Mallorca
Airport. We offer a **comprehensive range of information** for every aspect of your journey,
including live updates on PMI departure and arrival times, details on airport facilities, and
practical guidance on travel to and from the airport. We aim to provide** clear, relevant, and
current insights**, so you can make the most of your  time on the island. We’re passionate about

About Palma Airport

Palma de Mallorca Airport (PMI), also known as Son Sant Joan Airport, is the gateway to the
wonderful island of Mallorca. It’s the place where most people begin and end their holiday. Palma
Airport is the **third-largest** airport in Spain, with close to** 34 million passengers every
year**, dispatching **more than 12,000 passengers per hour** during busy periods. In the peak summer
months, this dual-runway airport handles as many movements as Heathrow, the busiest airport in
Europe.

team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic

opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

## About Us

Our Mission is to optimally enable persons with Locomotor Disabilities by quality interventions that
go beyond their medical needs and to provide him/her need based comprehensive rehabilitation through
team approach facilitating inclusion, ensuring empowerment of their families and by substantiating
field based research and development of human resources, so as to achieve their social and economic
independence, train Rehabilitation Professionals and undertake Research.

To actualize the potential of every person with locomotor disability and to ensure him/her equal
opportunities, equal rights to lead a qualitative life to protect their rights and full
participation in the society, with committed professionalism, accessible environment, positive
attitudes and appropriate, affordable, acceptable and available technological interventions.

# Crutches that actually fit *tall* people.

Walk into a pharmacy at 6'4" and the crutches on the shelf will not fit you. Most retail "tall
adult" sizes stop around 6'2". The In-Motion Tall line is built for the rest of us: underarm
crutches that fit to 7'1" and forearm crutches that fit to 6'8", each rated to 350 lbs.

[See the In-Motion Tall crutch][7] [Find your size first][8]

Made by Millennial Medical, St. George, Utah · Spring-assisted · 350 lb capacity

Why this site exists

## Tall people get the leftovers of the crutch market

Crutch sizing is built around the average body. Standard adult forearm crutches typically adjust to
a handle height of 36 to 38 inches, which runs out somewhere around 6'0" to 6'2" depending on your
proportions. Past that, people end up hunching over crutches that are too short, which puts your
wrists, shoulders, and posture in positions they were never meant to hold.

The fix is not "extend the poles and hope." A crutch that fits a taller body needs a longer
adjustment range, more height positions so the fit lands exactly, and a weight rating that matches a
bigger frame. That is what the In-Motion Tall line was designed for.

### Standard retail crutches
* Handle height stops near 36 to 38 inches
* Fit runs out around 6'0" to 6'2"
* Ratings stop at 250 or 300 lbs
* Hunching, shrugging, bent elbows

### In-Motion Tall
* Cradle adjusts 48" to 62"
* Fits to 7'1" underarm, 5'3" to 6'8" forearm
* Rated to 350 lbs
* 15 positions, exact fit

The In-Motion difference

## Built for full-size bodies, not just longer tubes

15 handle positions | 350 lb rated | spring assist | articulating tips

[Upper post of the In-Motion forearm crutch showing the height adjustment holes, cuff, and ergonomic
handle] 01

### A real tall range

The Tall underarm model adjusts from 48" to 62" floor-to-cradle across 15 positions, fitting users
from 5'10" to 7'1". The Tall forearm model fits 5'3" to 6'8".

[Woman walking a desert trail at sunset using In-Motion forearm crutches] 02

### Spring assist

Millennial Medical's Spring Assist Technology is designed to absorb impact as you walk, reducing it
by up to 40% compared to a rigid post. Taller users put more force through every step, so this
matters more the bigger you are.

[Pair of articulating crutch tips] 03

### Ergonomic handles + articulating tips

Contoured left and right handles keep wrists in a neutral position, and articulating tips stay flat
on the ground through your stride, on pavement, grass, gravel, and indoor floors.

[Person walking on a track using In-Motion forearm crutches] 04

### 350 lb capacity

Both Tall models are rated to 350 lbs. Many retail crutches stop at 250 or 300, which rules them out
for a lot of the people who need the tall sizing in the first place.

Two ways to get the fit

## Which In-Motion Tall is yours?

5'10" – 7'1"

### Underarm, fits 5'10" to 7'1"

The familiar style, in a size almost nobody else makes. Floor-to-cradle adjusts from 48" to 62",
which covers users past 7 feet. If you are very tall, this is likely the only off-the-shelf crutch
that fits. SKU 6500, HCPCS E0117.

[View at Millennial Medical][10]
5'3" – 6'8"

### Forearm (Lofstrand), fits 5'3" to 6'8"

The pick for longer-term or active use. Your hands and forearms carry the load, your arms swing
naturally, and the cuffs let you free a hand without dropping the crutch. SKU 7500C, HCPCS E0110.

[View at Millennial Medical][11]

Not sure which range you land in? Start with [the sizing guide][12] or check [Millennial Medical's
full spec sheet][13].
